verification_subject_is_who_it_says.name: verification_subject_is_who_it_says
verification_subject_is_who_it_says.value: ("verification_subject"."kind" = 'individual' AND "verification_subject"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_subject"."user_id" = "verification_subject"."id" AND "verification_subject"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR ("verification_subject"."kind" = 'organization' AND "verification_subject"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_subject"."organization_id" = "verification_subject"."id" AND "verification_subject"."user_id" IS NULL)

wallet_link_linked_has_signature.name: wallet_link_linked_has_signature
wallet_link_linked_has_signature.value: "wallet_link"."status" = 'pending' OR ("wallet_link"."signature" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_link"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_link"."signed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
